children: EQT is acquiring Range Resources in an all-stock transaction that creates a natural gas producer with a pro forma enterprise value exceeding $50 billion. The combined company will have net production above nine Bcfe/d and more than 30 years of inventory across nearly three million net acres, the companies said. The deal positions EQT as what it calls the only vertically integrated natural gas producer in America with leading inventory depth. Each Range share converts to 0.987 EQT shares, with the transaction expected to close in the first quarter of 2027
